test.title: A person you know who is very good at their job

document.cue: Describe a person you know who is very good at their job.

text: The person I'd like to talk about is my uncle Marat, who runs a small car repair workshop on the outskirts of Almaty. He's my mother's younger brother, so I've known him all my life.

He's been fixing cars for over twenty years, and he started with almost nothing — just a garage and a set of second-hand tools. Now he has four mechanics working for him, and people drive from the other side of the city because someone recommended him.

I spent a couple of summers helping out in his workshop as a teenager, mostly handing him tools and making tea. What struck me was how he listened to customers. Before he even opened the bonnet, he'd ask them to describe the noise, when it started and how the car felt, and more often than not he'd guess the problem correctly before looking.

The main reason I think he's so good, though, is his honesty. If a repair isn't really necessary, he tells people straight away, even though it means he earns less. I once saw him send a woman home without charging her, because the 'problem' was just a loose cap. That's why his customers trust him completely.
So for me he's a reminder that being good at your job isn't only about skill — it's about how you treat people.

tips.en: The loose-cap story proves his honesty better than adjectives could.
tips.kk: Қақпақ оқиғасы адалдықты сын есімнен жақсы дәлелдейді.
tips.ru: Случай с крышкой доказывает честность лучше прилагательных.
tips.example: because the 'problem' was just a loose cap

tips.en: Isn't only about … it's about … ends with an idea, not just “that's all”.
tips.kk: Isn't only about … it's about … — «бар болғаны осы» емес, ой-қорытынды.
tips.ru: Isn't only about … it's about … — итог-мысль, а не «вот и всё».

title.en: A general point at the end

tips.example: being good at your job isn't only about skill

note.en: Who he is, what he does and how they know each other: three bullets in two sentences.
note.kk: Кім, немен айналысады және қайдан таныс — карточканың үш тармағы екі сөйлемде.
note.ru: Кто, чем занимается и откуда знакомы — три пункта карточки в двух фразах.

note.en: The path from a garage to a workshop shows growth through specific numbers.
note.kk: Гараждан шеберханаға дейінгі жол — нақты сандар арқылы өсу.
note.ru: Путь от гаража до мастерской — рост через конкретные цифры.

note.en: The speaker's own time in the workshop shows how he works.
note.kk: Шеберханадағы өз тәжірибесі — оның қалай жұмыс істейтінінің мысалы.
note.ru: Свой опыт в мастерской — пример того, как он работает.

note.en: The main reason is honesty, proved by the story of the loose cap.
note.kk: Басты себеп — адалдық, оны қақпақ оқиғасы дәлелдейді.
note.ru: Главная причина — честность, и её доказывает случай с крышкой.

note.en: The conclusion goes beyond one person: what it means to be good at a job.
note.kk: Қорытынды бір адамнан кеңірек: жақсы маман болу нені білдіреді.
note.ru: Вывод шире одного человека: что значит быть хорошим специалистом.
